description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.
